coder_notes: Only therapeutic agent is EGFR BATs (autologous T cells armed with anti-CD3 x anti-EGFR bispecific antibody) = cell therapy, excluded intervention type; registered as [DRUG] but is a cell product. LIFU device with microbubbles (Lumason, sulfur hexafluoride; not a registered intervention but used in every BBB opening) listed as delivery-enabling. 89Zr-oxine cell labelling for PET listed as diagnostic. Outcomes refer to 'after RT/TMZ' (standard chemoradiation is apparently given, exclusion says no GBM treatment besides surgery before entry), but temozolomide is not a registered intervention or described as part of study treatment, so not listed. EGFR IHC expression is an entry requirement linked to the EGFR-targeting cell therapy, but that is not a candidate, so candidate_matched false. Both arms are ACTIVE_COMPARATOR-labelled but differ only in LIFU schedule; neither is a true control. PET trafficking of labelled cells is not candidate tumour PK.
